title: Draft a reply to the landlord about the lease renewal
brief: Goal: a polite, firm reply to the owner's landlord, Ms. Alvarez (landlord@example.com), asking to renew at the increase the lease allows. Sources: ~/Documents/Lease/lease-2025.pdf, ~/Documents/Lease/landlord-notice.txt, and the city's rent page https://cityofsantacruz.example/rent-rules. Constraints: no commitments beyond renewing for 12 months; sign "Best, Sam". Done: the letter saved to the Library and an Apple Mail draft to landlord@example.com only; nothing sent.

input.content:
Dear Ms. Alvarez,

Thank you for your notice of October 20 about renewing the lease for 14 Seabright Ave, Apt 3, which ends on December 31, 2026.

I'd like to renew for another 12 months. The notice proposes a rent of $2,480 a month, up from $2,300, which is about 7.8%. The current lease (section 4) says increases at renewal are limited to 3%, which would be $2,369. Could we renew at that amount?

[check: whether the city's rent rules allow more than the lease does]

I'm happy to sign the renewal once we agree on the rent. I'll be at home most evenings if you'd like to talk it over.

Best,
Sam
